## amore v0.1.4

Release-ready MVP hardening for `ah-my-openresearch`.

### Highlights

- Adds provider model presets for `openai`, `anthropic`, and `google`.
- Wires persona overrides from `lab/config.json` into the OpenCode plugin runtime.
- Registers hidden `councillor-*` subagents for council sessions.
- Makes councillor subagents read-only.
- Hardens `council-session` to stop instead of falling back to fake/in-context council behavior.
- Updates `amore install` so it writes versioned plugin specs and no machine-local `skills.paths`.
- Cleans stale amore skills paths while preserving user paths.
- Adds stronger `amore doctor` validation for lab config, OpenCode wiring, bundled skills, edges, and generated index freshness.
- Refreshes the README and research skill docs.
- Adds GitHub CI and npm publish workflows.

### Verification

- `bun test`: 194 tests, 660 assertions.
- `bun run typecheck`: passed.
- `bun run check:ci`: passed.
- `bun run build`: passed.
- `npm pack --dry-run`: passed, 56 files.
- npm post-publish smoke passed with `bunx ah-my-openresearch@0.1.4 install --no-wiki --models anthropic` and `doctor`.

### Notes

The package is published to npm as `ah-my-openresearch@0.1.4`.
Clean MVP package: 6 personas, 16 skills, OpenCode wiring, install/doctor, and cleaned npm tarball.
